description.message: Reopen closed tabs in one click. Browse and search recently closed tabs.

actionTitle.message: Reopen last closed tab · Right-click for history

intro.message: A page worth coming back to.

pressHint.message: Click to reopen · Hold for history · Esc to hide the list

safariNotice.message: Safari records up to 1000 closed web tabs locally after installation. Reopening restores the URL, not page state or back/forward history. Private and internal tabs are excluded.

privacy.message: On your device. No analytics, accounts or external requests.

stale.message: This tab is no longer available. Refresh the list.

loadError.message: Could not load closed tabs. Try again.

contextMenuHelp.message: Add recovery and history to webpage right-click menus. Toolbar history is always available.

filterHelp.message: Only HTTP(S) pages are eligible. Extension pages, blank pages, new tabs and browser-internal pages are excluded. Closed windows containing excluded pages are skipped as a whole to avoid reopening them.

settingsError.message: Could not load or save settings. Try again.

minFontSizeHelp.message: 13–20px. Updates all open history and settings pages immediately.

settingsIntro.message: Adjust text size and recovery controls. Changes save automatically.
